run_id.description: The run's id, as list_runs or start_run returned it.

allow_unconfirmed.description: Opt in to a normative run over facade receivers that are still proposed or whose slab height is assumed. Without it such a run is refused; with it their counts are recorded in the run's provenance and report.

experimental.description: Opt in to a scaffold-tier standard. A scaffold is not an implementation of the method its name suggests; without this its run is refused.

facade_buildings.description: With receiver_mode facade: the building feature ids, from get_model, whose facades carry receivers.

facade_include_courtyard.description: With receiver_mode facade: also place receivers on courtyard facades.

facade_spacing_m.description: With receiver_mode facade: the station spacing along each facade in metres. Required there; there is no default.

params.description: Parameters of the profile by name, each value as a string. Omitted ones take the default list_standards declares; provenance.json records the values the run resolved.

receiver_mode.description: auto-grid (a receiver grid over the sources or the calc-area), custom (the model's receiver features) or facade (receivers generated on the facades of facade_buildings; rls19-road and schall03 only).

scenario_id.description: The scenario to run; default in a new project.

standard_profile.description: One of that version's profiles, from list_standards.

standard_version.description: One of the standard's versions, from list_standards.

crs.description: EPSG identifier to answer in, such as EPSG:4326. Omitted, the run's compute_crs.

interval.description: Contour step in dB. Omitted, the API's default step.
